description: Read the current platform data-release version (current_release_major/minor) and snapshot timestamp. Does not refresh the registry or change saved data. Returns DATA_RELEASE_UNAVAILABLE if the registry is not populated yet. Requires 'discovery' scope.
name: get_data_release

as_of.description: ISO timestamp of the registry snapshot

count_state.description: Unknown means no count; available does not guarantee freshness. Recount for a current value.

guidance.description: Interpretation or recovery guidance for this result

next_actions.description: Suggested next calls using returned IDs and available scopes. Not executed and not user consent.

page_count.description: Number of objects on this page, not the organization total

population_input.description: Population input used for the preview; IDs refer to their current saved definitions

title: Get Data Release
